# Deep Work — Cal Newport

The ability to focus without distraction is becoming rare and more valuable at the same time.

- Schedule every minute of the workday, then adjust when plans break.
- Embrace boredom: don't reach for the phone in every queue.
- Shut down completely at the end of the day with a fixed ritual.

What I'm trying: no email before 11am, two 90-minute blocks a day.
